decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual speakers, as several items were cases or chargers. My consideration set includes a mix of ultra-portable (JBL Clip 3), mid-range power (Raymate, XENEO), floating/waterproof (Comiso), and premium high-fidelity (Audio Pro). I ultimately chose the JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_147) because it has exceptional social proof with over 68,000 reviews and a high 4.7 rating. Its durability and portability make it the most reliable choice for a general-purpose Bluetooth speaker among the options provided.
